invalid/action-extra-member.json.rule: the button has a label and an address, nothing else

invalid/action-href-javascript.json.rule: the button's address follows a page's rules too

invalid/action-label-too-long.json.rule: the button's label has at most 18 characters, fewer than a link's

invalid/action-missing.json.rule: no button is null, not an absent member

invalid/action-string.json.rule: the button is a link or null

invalid/dup-key-name.json.rule: a name given twice: each parser would see a different header (a rule)

invalid/footer-extra-member.json.rule: the footer has a lead and a text, nothing else

invalid/footer-lead-too-long.json.rule: the lead has at most 80 characters

invalid/footer-not-an-object.json.rule: the footer is two lines, by name

invalid/footer-text-blank.json.rule: the text has a visible character

invalid/footer-text-too-long.json.rule: the text has at most 160 characters

invalid/json-trailing-comma.json.rule: trailing commas are not JSON (a rule)

invalid/menu-href-javascript.json.rule: no javascript: address, as on a page

invalid/menu-href-newline-then-https.jso.rule: a line that hides a second address

invalid/menu-href-protocol-relative.json.rule: no //host: a path starts with one slash

invalid/menu-href-space.json.rule: no raw space: the editor percent-encodes it

invalid/menu-href-too-long.json.rule: an address has at most 2048 characters

invalid/menu-href-trailing-newline.json.rule: a newline after a good address

invalid/menu-href-user-info.json.rule: no user info before the host

invalid/menu-label-blank.json.rule: a link's label has a visible character

invalid/menu-label-too-long.json.rule: a link's label has at most 24 characters

invalid/menu-label-zero-width.json.rule: zero-width spaces are not a visible character

invalid/menu-link-extra-member.json.rule: a link has a label and an address, nothing else

invalid/menu-link-null.json.rule: a link of the menu is a link, never null (only the button may be)

invalid/name-bell.json.rule: no control character in a name

invalid/name-empty.json.rule: the name has a visible character

invalid/name-line-separator.json.rule: a line separator breaks the line too

invalid/name-lone-surrogate.json.rule: a lone high surrogate: Ruby's parser refuses it, JavaScript's reads it (a rule)

invalid/name-missing.json.rule: every member is there, the button too (null for none)

invalid/name-nbsp-only.json.rule: no-break spaces are not a visible character

invalid/name-too-long.json.rule: the name has at most 28 characters

invalid/unknown-member-time-zone.json.rule: the time zone is the CMS's setting, not the editor's: a member the header and footer do not have

valid/bare.json.rule: no menu and no button: the menu may be empty, and null says there is no button

valid/every-limit-in-code-points.json.rule: lengths count code points, as maxLength does in both engines: 28 emoji, and letters written as letter plus combining accent

valid/every-limit.json.rule: every length at its limit: 28 for the name, 8 links of 24, 18 for the button, 80 and 160 for the footer

valid/every-link-form.json.rule: every form a link may take, as on a page: https, http, mailto, tel, a path, a section of a page, a query, a fragment

valid/non-ascii.json.rule: names and words in other scripts and with accents, right to left included

valid/slack-water.json.rule: the example site's header and footer, as config/site.yml gives them; each invalid file changes one thing in it
